confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not live listings. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation anchors are less certain and assume July high-season pricing, with taxes included. Beer, cocktail and wine are weakest: alcohol is served only in licensed venues, so the drink anchors use a local price relationship to beer and are bounded rather than observed. The FX observation is the 16 Oct 2026 RBA figure from the statistics page; the 15 Oct figure is the best-corroborated value.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Atlantic and Mediterranean coastal Moroccan resort towns with similar tourist mix and seasonal pricing (for example Agadir and Tangier), adjusted for Essaouira's smaller scale and its mix of riads and guesthouses in the medina. Drink anchors are set relative to the beer anchor.
